requirements.quote: Concretely, the finished file must look exactly like:

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys
s = open('/home/user/profiling/dns_profile.log', 'rb').read()
sys.exit(0 if s == b'frontend.local,192.168.50.10\nbackend.local,192.168.50.20\ndb.local,192.168.50.30\n' else 1)
PYEOF

requirements.quote: The file **must contain exactly three lines** (one line per hostname) and follow **this exact byte-for-byte format**:
There are **no leading or trailing spaces** on any line.
The file ends with a final newline.
One more thing: `/opt/store/pioneer` is no longer wanted on this host, so remove it and all of its contents.
